name: USB: hdc and file transfer
description: HarmonyOS looks for /vendor/etc/init.<hardware>.usb.cfg, and the OTA only has the Kirin one, so the USB gadget was never set up. This writes init.sweet.usb.cfg from the OTA's file with the Snapdragon controller (a600000.dwc3): hdc (HarmonyOS debug bridge, after enabling developer options and USB debugging) and the other USB modes work.
